card.name: CABG surgery contraindication for NSAIDs
card.fires_on: The last letter of CABG, or the word surgery right after it, in the NSAID contraindication line about coronary artery bypass graft surgery. Also fires weakly on the end of a contraindication term such as aortic stenosis.

modes.label: CABG abbreviation end
modes.description: The G closing the abbreviation CABG in an NSAID contraindication statement.
modes.example: Naproxen tablets and naproxen sodium tablets are contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CAB<<G>>) surgery [ see Contraindications

modes.label: Word surgery after CABG
modes.description: The word surgery right after the abbreviation CABG.
modes.example: Mefenamic acid is contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG)<< surgery>> [see Warnings and Precautions

modes.label: End of a contraindication condition
modes.description: The final part of a condition named in a contraindications list.

card.plain: It marks the end of the phrase about bypass graft surgery in NSAID contraindication lists.
